objective: Measure whether mixed K3/K4 QSRT candidates that preserve accepted reconstructed-activation down-refit targets can reduce forward KLD while retaining a strictly smaller logical representation than the immutable 3.5-bpw EXL3 comparison panel.

source_weights.scope: the existing five-shard layer-3 BF16 source window

reporting_reference.role: published BF16 teacher logits used only after both allocations are frozen
reporting_reference.evidence_limit: one context can screen a mechanism but cannot establish document-level replication

revision_boundary: The bounded source tensors come from revision b4734de4. The published reporting logits name revision 4d67f66c. The experiment records those roles separately and does not claim that the two revisions are byte-identical.

selection_inputs.candidate_selection_role: the only inputs permitted to choose a data-dependent K3/K4 allocation

base_representation.description: K3 gate and up encodes plus the frozen reconstructed-activation K3 down refit, with the ordinary source-target K3 down encode retained wherever the refit was rejected

candidate_construction.accepted_down_refit: recompute the continuous fitted target from activation-fit rows and the stored ridge factor, require its K3 re-encode to equal the stored refit, then encode the same continuous target at K4
candidate_construction.rejected_down_refit: retain the ordinary source-target K3 tensor and use the reusable source-target K4 tensor
candidate_construction.gate_and_up: reuse source-target K3 and K4 tensors from their hash-closed artifacts
candidate_construction.selection_metric: pooled route-weighted complete-expert output squared error on candidate-selection documents

logical_byte_gate.serialized_gate: The allocation remains a mechanism screen until a materialized GLM QSRT container charges headers, format directories, alignment, padding, scales, and the shared reconstruction table and remains strictly smaller than the comparison checkpoint.

fixed_exl3_rate_stratified_allocation.description: Promote every panel projection whose immutable EXL3 rate is at least four, cap the two EXL3 five-bit projections at K4, then spend the one remaining promotion in frozen expert and projection order.

k4_projections.reason: first remaining projection in frozen expert and projection order
EXL3 rate five capped at K4
EXL3 rate five capped at K4

complete_expert_selection_allocation.description: Assemble all eight legal K3/K4 tuples for every expert and minimize pooled route-weighted complete-expert output squared error under the twelve-promotion budget.
complete_expert_selection_allocation.objective_boundary: The score evaluates the complete SwiGLU expert so gate, up, and down errors interact. It does not authorize a model-quality claim.
complete_expert_selection_allocation.tie_break: For equal pooled objective values, choose the lexicographically earliest sequence of per-expert rate tuples in the frozen expert order and gate, up, down projection order.

acceptance.required_model_quality_measurement: paired forward KL divergence from the published BF16 teacher logits to each frozen candidate on the reporting context
acceptance.required_replication: additional document-disjoint BF16 reference contexts before a generalization claim
acceptance.primary_claim_boundary: A layer-3 expert panel is a mechanism screen; it cannot establish complete-checkpoint dominance.
